title: AI 抢走好莱坞？：Luma 说要带回来，降本提速不牺牲控制
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: AI startup Luma AI says the technology could actually help bring production back to Los Angeles by lowering costs and making ambitious projects faster and easier to produce without sacrificing
segments.zh: AI初创公司Luma AI表示，这项技术实际上可以通过降低成本、让雄心勃勃的项目更快更容易地制作，从而帮助将制作带回洛杉矶，同时不牺牲

segments.en: creative control. Luma AI, CEO Caroline Ingeborn, joins us now. You and I were listening to Mr. Affleck together last night. His view on AI's role in the filmmaking process or the creative process.
segments.zh: 创意控制。Luma AI首席执行官Caroline Ingeborn现在加入我们。你和我昨晚一起听了Affleck先生的观点。他对AI在电影制作或创意过程中角色的看法。

segments.en: Obviously Luma believes AI has a role. Just explain what Luma does and how you make a role in Hollywood.
segments.zh: 显然Luma相信AI有一席之地。请解释一下Luma做什么，以及你如何在好莱坞发挥作用。

segments.en: So Luma started out as a frontier research lab. That's right. What we are today is a full stack company. So what that means is that we do research on multimodal AI models. But then what
segments.zh: 所以Luma最初是一个前沿研究实验室。没错。我们今天是一家全栈公司。这意味着我们研究多模态AI模型。但然后

segments.en: where a product is and how we go to market is focused on AI for creative work. Yeah.
segments.zh: 产品在哪里以及我们如何进入市场，都专注于AI用于创意工作。是的。

segments.en: And so if you look at this of how the how the industry has evolved it is first like you need these models to be able to do anything right. But if you only use the models
segments.zh: 所以如果你看看这个行业如何演变，首先你需要这些模型能够做任何事情，对吧。但如果你只使用模型

segments.en: they are very unruly. And you saw this in the early user behavior. So the second layer of this is building products for creative professionals so that they can access the models but also like
segments.zh: 它们非常难以控制。你在早期用户行为中看到了这一点。所以第二层是为创意专业人士构建产品，这样他们可以访问模型，但也

segments.en: retain control. And the third layer is having forward deploy creatives and engineers
segments.zh: 保持控制。第三层是拥有前沿部署的创意人员和工程师
